# teacher

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:teacher`](gmeow-teacher.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/teacher>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/learning`](../../slices/learning.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The agent providing instruction in a [`gmeow:Teaching`](../classes/gmeow-Teaching.md) relation. Functional: one teaching, one teacher; co-teaching is several [`gmeow:Teaching`](../classes/gmeow-Teaching.md) relators sharing a [`gmeow:subjectTaught`](gmeow-subjectTaught.md) and a [`gmeow:learner`](gmeow-learner.md) set. The teacher must differ from every [`gmeow:learner`](gmeow-learner.md) of the same [`Teaching`](../classes/gmeow-Teaching.md) (gmeow:TeachingShape).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Teaching`](../classes/gmeow-Teaching.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:teacher`](gmeow-teacher.md) from [`gmeow:Teaching`](../classes/gmeow-Teaching.md) to [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

# --- The reified instruction: one teacher, TWO learners taught together, one

    gmeow:teacher ex:mentor ;
    gmeow:learner ex:lillith, ex:rowan ;
    gmeow:subjectTaught ex:balancing ;
    rdfs:label "a group balancing lesson"@en .

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Teaching`](../classes/gmeow-Teaching.md), [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to bind a [`gmeow:Teaching`](../classes/gmeow-Teaching.md) to the single [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) giving instruction — the mandatory, functional teacher player of the relator.

### Avoid when

- Avoid more than one teacher per [`Teaching`](../classes/gmeow-Teaching.md) (it is functional — co-teaching is several Teachings) and never point it at an agent that is also a [`gmeow:learner`](gmeow-learner.md) of the same [`Teaching`](../classes/gmeow-Teaching.md) (gmeow:TeachingShape forbids teacher = learner).

### How to use

- Point the [`Teaching`](../classes/gmeow-Teaching.md) at exactly one [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) as teacher; bind the learner(s) with [`gmeow:learner`](gmeow-learner.md) and the content with [`gmeow:subjectTaught`](gmeow-subjectTaught.md), keeping teacher and learner distinct.
